title: Tech support pop-up
summary: A pop-up or call claims the device has a problem and asks for payment or access.
scenario: The warning prevents normal use and directs you to an unexpected caller or download.
warning_signs: Phone number shown only in the warning
Request for remote access or payment
safe_actions: Do not call the displayed number
Close the tab or app safely and use known device support
Do not install tools at the request of the pop-up
recovery_guidance: Update security software and review installed apps
Change credentials if remote access was granted
reporting_guidance: Record the warning and software context
prevention_tips: Browser warnings do not require an incoming caller
Keep the operating system and browser updated
false_positive_notes: Real security alerts can appear, but verify them through the device's normal security settings.
